name: opencode-ai
title: OpenCode AI
description: Use OpenCode Zen and Go models in Raycast AI and chat with them in a standalone command.
author: alhassanaraouf

commands.name: ask-opencode-ai
commands.title: Ask OpenCode AI
commands.subtitle: Zen & Go
commands.description: Ask questions using OpenCode Zen and Go models, with conversation history.

preferences.title: OpenCode API Key
preferences.name: OPENCODE_API_KEY
preferences.description: OpenCode Zen API key from https://opencode.ai/auth. Stored only in Raycast preferences.

preferences.title: Default Model
preferences.name: OPENCODE_MODEL
preferences.description: Model preselected in Ask OpenCode AI, e.g. go/gpt-6-luna (Go) or claude-sonnet-5 (Zen)

preferences.title: Model Sources
preferences.name: OPENCODE_ZEN
preferences.label: Show OpenCode Zen models
preferences.description: List pay-as-you-go OpenCode Zen models. Uncheck if you only use Go.

preferences.name: OPENCODE_GO
preferences.label: Show OpenCode Go models
preferences.description: List models from your OpenCode Go subscription (same API key) as `<model> (Go)`. Uncheck if you don't subscribe to Go.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
